items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a geometrically irreducible smooth projective scheme over a finite separable extension the cycle class map on zero cycles factors through the degree map (statement lines 3696-3703). The proof (proof lines 3704-3734) reduces to points with separable residue fields, base changes along a finite Galois extension to reach rational points, and uses divisibility of the difference together with the relations lemma. H3: a three stage reduction using base change and divisibility, written out in full.
